result.circuitDescription: Bell pair: H on q0, CNOT q0->q1, measure q0->c0 and q1->c1
facts: Counts from one job on the backend chosen in Qollab's Select QPU dialog, which reported itself as 'basic_simulator'.
Circuit: H on q0, CNOT from q0 to q1, then measure both qubits. An ideal simulator gives only 00 and 11; noise or hardware can add 01 and 10.
256 of 256 shots (100.0%) had both qubits agree (00 or 11).
Each key reads right to left: the right bit is q0, the left bit is q1 (Qiskit's order).
This is a Bell-pair correlation check, not teleportation. Teleportation is verified by exact local Qiskit statevector math in the game.
The agreement carries no message: on its own, each qubit reads 0 or 1 at random.
If the selected backend is a simulator, these counts are a simulation, not a measurement of a physical quantum device.
